favouriteVault.definition: vault holding the most value in the period (deposits and received transfers both count)

whatIfHeld.definition: vault yield your withdrawn shares would have earned had they stayed: exit-day assets x PPS growth to today. Vault-level attribution, not personal profit and loss, and it assumes the money would have stayed in the vault
whatIfHeld.source: Kong daily PPS and historical underlying price

valuation.definition: daily USD value of held positions (shares x historical PPS x asset price)

vaultGrowth.definition: vault yield earned (protocol return) attributed to your positions during the recap period, estimated from daily PPS and historical underlying prices; not personal investment profit

behaviour.definition: timing and holding-time shape of your own in-and-out traffic. hour and weekday counts are chain time (UTC) and the deck rotates hours to the viewer's clock. holding spans come from the share timeline, so a position already open on day one counts from day one
